turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The paint is peeling off my window frames outside. Do I need to strip all of it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Not necessarily all. Scrape off anything loose or flaky until you hit paint that's firmly stuck.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, I'm visiting a new city for one morning and I've found three cafes I want to try.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want your opinion, but only after you've heard every option. I'll say when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A tiny specialty roaster near the station that only does pour overs, standing room only.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big old fashioned coffee house with chandeliers, cakes and waiters in waistcoats.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a little rooftop place with a view over the river, but it's a twenty minute walk uphill.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you love coffee itself, the roaster is the one, though you'll be standing. The coffee house is about the atmosphere and the cake. The rooftop is the most memorable view, if you don't mind the climb.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, sand the edges so there's no ridge, then fill any cracks in the wood with exterior filler.
